ai_summary: This document is a routine compliance filing by 5paisa Capital Limited, submitted to the stock exchanges for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. It confirms that the company's Registrar and Share Transfer Agent processed all dematerialization requests according to SEBI regulations (74(5)), ensuring physical certificates were cancelled, and ownership records updated within the prescribed timelines. The report indicates sound operational compliance with no red flags, signifying proper handling of investor securities.
